scope: Compact fixed-world diagnostic projection of all 26 successful two-year runs and matched comparisons. Not a checkpoint, periodic climatology, Earth calibration, arbitrary-parameter stability, or proof of temporal/spatial convergence. Original native JSON reports are reproducible with the documented commands.
omittedNativeSummaryFields: Monthly bin boundaries derive exactly from yearIndex/monthIndex and the pinned 365-day calendar. Global sampled soil/snow means, per-group runoff/stock means outside land, and redundant group area fields can be regenerated; all land stock means, global/land precipitation, global rain/snowfall/evaporation, land runoff, positive/nonpositive uplift land area/rainfall, regional totals, and paired regional changes are retained.

suites.scope: Accepted hourly observations only. Numbered month totals retain separate year indices; no climatology or spin-up qualification. Soil/snow means use right-endpoint quadrature with signed low components. Generated runoff is donor production, not routed gross edge departures or hydraulic discharge. Fixed-world parameter interventions use shared actual coupling; spatial groups use raw monthly uplift and initial dry land, not inferred rain-shadow labels. No model/default/protocol change, physical calibration, cross-resolution convergence, or universal monotonic response is claimed.
